# ankra_organisation_custom_dns_zone (Resource)

A DNS zone you own that every cluster in the organisation serves, publishing records with your own credential (an `ankra_dns_credential` webhook, an `ankra_cloudflare_credential`, or an Avura credential). Removing it withdraws the zone from every cluster that did not declare it itself; the zone and its records are left untouched. The counterpart of `ankra org custom-dns-zones add|remove`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ankra_dns_credential" "webhook" {
  name                 = "corporate-dns"
  webhook_provider_url = var.dns_webhook_url
}

resource "ankra_organisation_custom_dns_zone" "corporate" {
  zone            = "apps.example.com"
  credential_name = ankra_dns_credential.webhook.name
}

variable "dns_webhook_url" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `credential_name` (String) Name of the organisation credential that publishes into the zone. Changing it rebinds the zone in place.
- `zone` (String) Zone to serve, such as `example.com`, in lower case without a trailing dot. Changing it replaces the declaration.

### Optional

- `provider_kind` (String) Credential family: `webhook`, `cloudflare` or `avura`. The platform derives it from the credential; set it to assert the family, which the platform checks. Sent as `provider`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The zone name.
- `policy` (String) external-dns policy the clusters run for the zone, as the platform chose it for the credential family.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Organisation-wide custom DNS zones are imported by zone name.
terraform import ankra_organisation_custom_dns_zone.corporate apps.example.com
```
